sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं भूमौ राक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम् ।व्यथिता राक्षसाः सर्वे क्षितिकम्प इव द्रुमाः ।। ६.५६.३१ ।।।।
transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā nihataṁ bhūmau rākṣasendramakampanam ।vyathitā rākṣasāḥ sarve kṣitikampa iva drumāḥ ।। 6.56.31 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing Akampana lying dead on the ground, the Rakshasas were shaken like the trees in the earthquake and were distressed.
